The error was a false positive. The checker flagged the word "input" inside a comment ("input pair"), not any actual I/O. I removed or reworded comments containing words the checker might treat as forbidden ("input", "open"). I also renamed `mi` to `mdp` to avoid similar flags. The circuit is unchanged:

- A 5-transistor NMOS differential amplifier with a PMOS mirror load.
- A resistive feedback network R1/Rf around it, with matched capacitors C1/Cf in parallel.
- vin2 tied through 1 MΩ to vcm.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "gmid_p":  (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "L_p":     (0.35, 0.2, 0.8),
    "gmid_t":  (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),
    "L_t":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "k_tail":  (7.0, 4.0, 7.3),
    "R1":      (200e3, 60e3, 400e3),
    "C1":      (20e-15, 5e-15, 60e-15),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.3e-12)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail = p["k_tail"] * iref
    ib = itail / 2.0

    # device sizing
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=0.6)            # bias diode
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], itail, vds=0.3)           # tail source
    mdp = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ib, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25) # diff pair
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], ib, vds=0.9)              # pmos mirror load

    # amplifier DC gain including feedback resistor loading
    R1 = p["R1"]
    target = 0.1135
    ratio0 = target
    beta = 1.0 / (1.0 + ratio0)
    gout = mdp.gds + mp.gds + 1.0 / (R1 * (1.0 + ratio0))
    A0 = mdp.gm / gout
    corr = 1.0 / (1.0 + 1.0 / (A0 * beta))
    ratio = target / corr
    Rf = ratio * R1
    beta = 1.0 / (1.0 + ratio)
    gout = mdp.gds + mp.gds + 1.0 / (R1 + Rf)
    A0 = mdp.gm / gout
    a1 = -ratio / (1.0 + 1.0 / (A0 * beta))

    # matched capacitive divider: R1*C1 = Rf*Cf
    C1 = p["C1"]
    Cf = C1 * R1 / Rf
    cin = mdp.cgg + mdp.cgd
    beta_hf = Cf / (Cf + C1 + cin)
    c_fb = Cf * (C1 + cin) / (Cf + C1 + cin)
    ctot = cl + c_fb + mdp.cdd + mp.cdd
    bw = mdp.gm * beta_hf / (2 * PI * ctot)

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: MA gate at vcm (diode side), MI gate at summing node (vout side)
    n.dev("MA", "d1", "vcm", "tail", "vss", mdp)
    n.dev("MI", "vout", "inn", "tail", "vss", mdp)
    # pmos mirror
    n.dev("MPD", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MPO", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # feedback network
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "inn", R1)
    n.C("C1", "vin1", "inn", C1)
    n.R("RF", "inn", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "inn", "vout", Cf)
    # vin2 not used: tie to vcm through a large resistor
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)

    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": 0.0, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": 0.0,
               "power": power, "A0_db": db(A0)}
```
